item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built in the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it’s running. We must face that reality before we build something we can’t stop.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and once it is running, no one will be able to shut it down. The time to act is before it exists.

3. Once superintelligent AI is running, no one will be able to shut it down—if it’s built within the next 20 years. We must make decisions about its development with that fact in view.

**(b) Newsletter opening — 104 words**

We are approaching a threshold with consequences we cannot reverse. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. That is not a distant technical detail; it is the central fact we must confront as decisions about AI development are made today. We cannot wait until such a system exists and then assume we can switch it off if things go wrong. The window to shape what gets built, and whether it gets built at all, is now. We must treat this prospect with the seriousness it demands and act before the point of no return.
